name_in_source: Pkt. Siṃghala, Skt. Siṃhala, Pa. Sīhala; Tāmraparṇī, Ratnadvīpa, Laṅkā etc.
identification: Ceylon (Sri Lanka); capital Anurādhapura in the north of the island
quote: 僧伽羅,俗語 Simghala 音譯,梵文 Simhala…一九七二年改名為斯里蘭卡(Srilanka)…即該島北部的阿努拉達普拉(Anuradhapura),舊譯阿克羅陀城
note: Xuanzang did not visit; the 7000-li circuit is hearsay. Notes the 1972 renaming (not scholarship). Agrees with Mizutani

identification: Mahāvihāra, S of old Anurādhapura, founded by Devānampiyatissa; remains near the Ruvanveli stūpa
others_reported: Faxian: 7 li S of the city
quote: 天愛帝須王(Devanampiyatissa)於古都阿羅陀城(Anarādhapura)…今古城之南的 Ruvanveli 塔附近還有其遺跡

identification: Abhayagiri, N of the royal city, built by Vaṭṭagāmaṇi Abhaya
others_reported: Faxian: great stūpa N of the royal city
quote: 阿跋耶祇釐,梵文Abhayagiri 音譯…於王城北跡上起大塔…吒迦摩尼王(Vattagāmani,一名無畏王 Abhaya)所建

identification: a hearsay island; by direction and distance probably the Maldives
others_reported: also a Coconut Island midway on the Colombo–Albany route
quote: 此係傳聞中的島嶼,不詳其確切所在。按其方向及距離,似卽馬爾代夫羣島…參閱謝方《中國史籍中之馬爾代夫考》,載《南亞研究》,1982
note: post-1971: 謝方, 中國史籍中之馬爾代夫考, 南亞研究 1982/2, 1–6. Differs from Mizutani, who gives no identification

identification: unidentified; probably the high mountains of S Sri Lanka
quote: 迦山具體指今何山,不詳。可能指該島國南部的高山

name_in_source: Skt. Koṅkaṇapura; 方志 恭達那補羅 → Kuntalapura
identification: Tungabhadrā basin from the W coast across the Western Ghats; capital Annagundi on the N bank of the Tungabhadrā (following Cunningham)
others_reported: St. Martin: Banavāsi; Cunningham: Tungabhadrā basin, capital Annagundi; Fergusson: in Mysore; Yazdani: Kuntalapura = Kubattūr, Shimoga; Burgess: near Kopal or Kokanūr; Fleet: Karnūl, later Burgess's view; Watters: Dakkanapura/Thakkanapura, no site; 足立喜六: Khanapur (rejected)
quote: 此國的考證,各家異說頗多…因此儘管關於恭建那補羅的問題還值得進一步研究,我們認為康寧哈姆的說法還是較爲中肯的…依康寧哈姆的意見,即通加巴德臘河北岸的安納貢底

name_in_source: Pkt. Mahāraṭṭha, Skt. Mahārāṣṭra; Aśokan Mahārathika
identification: upper Godāvarī basin and the land between it and the Krishna (modern Maharashtra), the W Chālukya kingdom of Pulakeśin II; capital Bādāmi (Vātāpipura)
others_reported: St. Martin: capital Devagiri (Deoghir); Cunningham: Kalyāṇī; Fleet, Burgess: Nāsik; most present scholars (B.C. Law): Bādāmi
quote: 摩訶剌侘國包括哥達瓦里河上游流域及該河與克里希那河之間地區…但當代學者更多認為玄奘時該國首都為巴達密(Badami)…這一比定較為可信,因為遷都納昔克是在玄奘巡禮該國之後
note: cites the Aihole inscription and Ṭabarī on Pulakeśin II's embassy to Khusrau II. Differs from Mizutani on the capital (Mizutani inclines to Nāsik)

identification: Ajanta caves, c.60 miles NW of Aurangabad, c.35 miles S of Bhusaval, in a bend of the Waghora
others_reported: most scholars agree
quote: 多數學者同意比定此地為阿旃陀(Ajantā)石窟寺,其位置在奧蘭伽巴德(Aurangabad)西北60英里

identification: Broach (Bharuch), ancient port on the N bank of the Narmadā
others_reported: Julien: Barou-gatcheva; St. Martin: Bäroukatcheva; Cunningham: Bharukaccha (followed); all agree on Broach
quote: 諸家一致的意見比定此國為今布羅奇(Broach或 Bharoach)
note: prefers the Cien zhuan bearing (NW). Agrees with Mizutani

name_in_source: Skt. Mālava; 南羅羅 (Skt. Lāṭa, Pa. Lāla)
identification: Malwa (Ujjain–Bhilsā area, part of old Avanti), the eastern Maitraka kingdom; capital probably Dhār (Dhārānagara)
others_reported: St. Martin, Cunningham, Beal, Fleet: Malwa; Smith: Kaira–Ahmadabad (N Gujarat), capital Ahmadabad (Asawal) on the Sābarmatī; Grierson, Lévi: against Smith, for Malwa; capital: Dhār (most of the Malwa school), Dongarpur (Beal)
quote: 一派(如聖馬丁、康寧哈姆、比爾,弗里特等人)比定此國相當於今馬爾瓦(Malwā)…我們基本上贊同前一派的說法…多數比定此國都為古城達爾(Dhār,古稱
note: Valabhī inscriptions (7th c.) favour Malwa; requires reading 西北 as 東北 and 南羅羅 as 北羅羅. Leans to Malwa more clearly than Mizutani, who leaves both views and the capital open

identification: undetermined, since the capital is uncertain
others_reported: Beal: the Brahman town at the Indus mouth on Alexander's return (too far from Dhār or Ahmadabad; kept only as a possibility)
quote: 由於摩臘婆國的都城的地望尚待探討,此邑也難於確定…該地位於印度河口,無論距達爾或阿默達巴德都太遠

identification: location unknown; probably a country known only by hearsay
others_reported: Julien: Atali; Watters: Adal, Akshal or Atli
quote: 此國地望不詳…阿吒釐國似爲傳聞之國,而非玄奘親踐之地
note: differs from Mizutani, who suggests the N coast of Kathiawar; also doubts that Xuanzang visited

identification: undecided
others_reported: Cunningham: Kheda = Kaira, reading 1300 li (rejected); Fergusson: Cambay at the head of the gulf; Julien, St. Martin: Kaccha = Cutch, followed by Watters, Smith, 堀謙德 (doubted: marshy, no finds)
quote: 這一分歧使此國的原名及其方位難於確定…在考古方面此地也未出土過任何歷史文物足以支持這一考證,因此關於此國的地望還有待繼續研究
note: agrees with Mizutani (both undecided, both doubt Cutch)

identification: Valabhī, Kathiawar peninsula (western Maitraka kingdom); capital Vala (Valabhipura ruins), 18 miles NW of Bhavnagar, 21°52′N 71°57′E
quote: 伐臘毗國的故都為訖利城 (Girinagara),卽現代的朱納加德(Junāgadh),約在五世紀中葉遷都於伐臘(Vala 或Wala)…保納加爾(Bhaonagar)西北18英里,北緯21度52分,東經71度57分地方
note: finds (inscriptions, seals) in the Prince of Wales Museum, Bombay; like Mizutani reads 北羅羅 as 南羅羅. Agrees with Mizutani

identification: Vadnagar, 17 miles SE of Sidhpur (N Gujarat)
others_reported: St. Martin: Barnagar 23 miles N of Ahmadabad; Cunningham, Watters: Sābarmatī–Banās doab; modern scholars: Vadnagar
quote: 聖馬丁比定此國為阿默達巴德以北 23英里的巴爾納加爾(Barnagar)…現代學者則比定為錫德普爾 (Sidhpur) 東南17 英里地方的瓦德納加爾(Vadnagar)
note: Xiyu ji wording suggests hearsay, but the Cien zhuan has Xuanzang there. Agrees with Mizutani

name_in_source: Pkt. Suraṭṭha, Skt. Surāṣṭra; Greek Syrastrene
identification: S Kathiawar peninsula; capital Junāgaḍh (Girinagara)
others_reported: Beal: capital E of the 莫醯 river (rejected)
quote: 此國在今卡提阿瓦半島南部…古代的訖哩納加羅(Girinagara,意卽山城)
note: cites the Junāgaḍh (Gupta) and Udayagiri inscriptions; reads 西據莫醯河 as the Mahī lying on the country's E. Agrees with Mizutani

identification: Mount Girnār, 10 miles E of Junāgaḍh, 3616 ft, Jaina holy mountain with cave temples, Aśokan rock edicts and Gupta inscriptions
quote: 郁鄯多,應還原作 Ujjanta…卽今日之訖爾納山(Girnār)…此山在朱納加德以東十英里處,高 3616英尺

name_in_source: Pkt. Gujjara, Skt. Gūrjara; capital Bhillamāla
identification: Gurjara kingdom in central Rajputana (near Jodhpur); capital Bhillamāla = Bārmer (Balmer), 25°48′N 71°16′E (following St. Martin)
others_reported: Smith, Majumdar: capital Bhinmāl (rejected as too far south); St. Martin: Bārmer; Cunningham: Bārmer lies 1800 li N of Valabhī; Munshi: Gurjaradeśa as a land name
quote: 史密斯與馬宗達等認為此城卽今賓馬爾(Bhinmal)…因此我們同意聖馬丁的看法,比定毘羅摩羅為北緯25度48分,東經71度16分處的巴爾默爾
note: differs from Mizutani on the capital (Mizutani follows the majority for Bhinmāl)

identification: Ujjain (Madhya Pradesh), capital of W (northern) Avanti
others_reported: Bhandarkar: Avanti had a S kingdom (Māhiṣmatī) and a N one (Ujjayinī)
quote: 該國的國都鄔闍衍那城即現今中央邦的烏賈因 (Ujjain)

identification: undecided: Bundelkhand (capital Khajurāho) or Chitor
others_reported: Cunningham, Smith: Jajhoti = Jejākabhukti = Bundelkhand, capital Khajurāho (majority); others: Chitor, capital Chitor (220 km N of Ujjain, not an old city)
quote: 目前雖然贊成前一種說法的人較多,但仍無法作出定論

identification: undecided: Mandla on the upper Narmadā or Gwalior
others_reported: Cunningham: Mandla (Māhiṣmatīpura), reading 北 as 南; Smith et al.: Gwalior, capital Gwalior (inscriptions show the temple no older than Mihirakula's time)
quote: 因此關於摩醯濕伐羅補羅的確切地望尚待進一步的研究
note: differs slightly from Mizutani, who takes the majority view (Gwalior); Ji leaves it open

name_in_source: Skt. Sindhu; capital 毘苫婆補羅
identification: Upper Sind centred on Sukkur (Cunningham); capital Alor (Aror)
others_reported: Cunningham: Upper Sind around Sukkur; Haig: incl. the Salt Range, capital near Derajāt; from Yijing's route (Watters): S Punjab between Bahawalpur and Shikarpur (few followers); capital name: Vichavapura (Julien), Vichālapura (St. Martin), Bichwāpura (Cunningham), Vasmapura (Beal), Vijñapura (Majumdar); Watters: an epithet
quote: 康寧哈姆比定信度國為今巴基斯坦信德省北部上信德(Upper Sindh)以蘇庫爾(Sukkur)爲中心的地帶…一般比定此城馬蘇庫爾地方的阿洛爾(Alor, Aror, Arore)

name_in_source: Mūlasthānapura (Julien Mulasambhura, St. Martin Mūlasthānipura, Watters Morasampuru/Molasampul)
identification: Multan, in the Chenab–Sutlej doab
others_reported: Cunningham: Multan, followed by Beal, Smith, B.C. Law and most
quote: 康寧哈姆比定為印度河支流奇納布 (Chenab) 河與薩特累季河間的三角洲上的木爾坦

identification: Harappa, Punjab (Pakistan)
others_reported: Cunningham, Smith: Jammu (c.250 miles from Multan, too far); modern scholars: Harappa
quote: 從前的學者,如康寧哈姆史密斯等人均比定爲克什米爾南部的查謨(Jammù)…近代學者多比定為巴基斯坦旁遮普省的哈拉巴(Harappa)

identification: country of the Audumbara people of Kacch at the Indus mouth; capital 朅䳢濕伐羅 = Kaccheśvara = Karachi
others_reported: Julien: Adhyavakila/Atyanvakela; Beal: Atyanabakela; Watters: Ādinavachila; Cunningham: Audumbatira/Audumbara (Lassen; Pliny Odomboeroe); capital: Khajiśvara (Julien), Kotiśvara (Cunningham), Kaccheśvara (Lassen, followed)
quote: 康氏的說法較為合理,但關於這一問題還可作進一步的研究…我們認為以拉森的說法為是。現比定為巴基斯坦的卡拉奇(Karachi)

name_in_source: Langala (Julien); Langa (St. Martin), Longhir (Beal), Lankar (Watters), Langhala (堀)
identification: E Mekran, SE Baluchistan; capital at the great ruined city of Lakoriān (Lakura) between Khozdar and Kalat
others_reported: capital name: Sunuriśvara (Julien, Beal), Sambhuriśvara (Cunningham, perhaps a temple name), Strīśvara (Watters)
quote: 其地望一般比定為莫克蘭(Mekran)的東部,現今巴基斯坦俾路支(Balüchistān)省東南部地方…胡茲達爾(Khozdar)與基拉特(Kilat)之間的拉柯利安(Lakoriān)地方的大故城廢墟

identification: Sasanian Persia (Iran); capital Persepolis (Istakhr)
quote: 薩珊王朝之國都爲 Persepolis,伊斯蘭教入侵後稱 Istakhr

identification: no identification of his own; reports only Beal's Ormus (Hormuz)
others_reported: Beal: Ormus = Hormuz (the only attempt)
quote: 鶴城至今只有比爾試比定爲Ormus,即現代有名的霍爾木茲(Hormuz)

identification: the Eastern Roman empire
others_reported: Hirth; 白鳥庫吉
quote: 拂懍國:指東羅馬。中古波斯語及粟特語作 From, Hrum

identification: a legend (originally an island in the Indian western ocean, moved west); not a real place
others_reported: 足立喜六: Siraf on the Persian Gulf (forced); Ibn Baṭṭūṭa and Portuguese sailors looked for it; Kennedy 1904
quote: 雖然這傳說荒誕不經,影響似乎不小,有人作過牽強附會的研究(如足立喜六就認為是指波斯灣上有名的港口尸羅夫

identification: Hyderabad (Sind) or Nirankot = Patalpur, Alexander's Patala (following Cunningham)
others_reported: Cunningham: Hyderabad / Nirankot; Haig: Nagar Parkar; 堀謙德: Shikarpur (both weaker)
quote: 康寧哈姆還原為Patāsila,並比定其地望爲海德拉巴德…海格(Haig)比定爲帕卡爾城(Nagar Parkar),堀謙德比定為錫卡爾普爾(Shikarpur),其理由均不如康氏的充足

identification: undecided
others_reported: Cunningham: Brāhmanābād (country and capital); Haig: Khairpur; 堀謙德: capital near Rajanpur
quote: 康寧哈姆比 定為婆羅門巴德(Brahmanabād)。海格認為這一都城應是開爾普爾(Khairpur)
note: Ji: all three lack firm evidence. Agrees with Mizutani

identification: Bannu on the Kurram, = Faxian's 跋那 (following Cunningham); capital Bannu
others_reported: Julien: Vaneh on the middle Gumal; Cunningham: Bannu
quote: 其地望儒蓮比定爲古瑪爾(Gumal)河中游的伐奈(Vaneh);康寧哈姆比定爲庫臘姆(Kuram)河畔的班努
note: finds the Cien zhuan itinerary hard to square with geography. Agrees with Mizutani

identification: a legendary country, hard to identify; two views kept as possibilities
others_reported: Reinaud, Elliot: Kykānān of the Arab historians (Kykan, at Chal); Stein: Waziristan W of Bannu
quote: 此為傳說之國,考訂頗為困難…上述兩者都只能姑備一說
note: differs slightly from Mizutani, who gives Waziristan; Ji leaves it open

name_in_source: Jāguda (saffron); Arm. Zuplastan, Zawulistān; Pahl. *Zapulistān; 慧超 Jawulasthāna
identification: Zabulistan: the Kabul–Kandahar region held by the Hephthalites; = 謝䫻 of the Xin Tang shu
others_reported: Markwart: from Pahlavi *Zapulistān
quote: 漕矩吒,梵文 Jāguda 之對音…嚈噠人於五世紀末據有Kabul 至 Kandahar 地區,稱之為Jawuda

identification: Ghazni, 155 km S of Kabul on the road to Kandahar
others_reported: Xin Tang shu: the king of 謝䫻 lives at 鶴悉那
quote: 鶴悉那,Ghazni 或 Ghaznin,今譯加兹尼或哥疾寧

identification: in the Helmand basin; perhaps Guzar
others_reported: Cunningham: Guzar
quote: 鶴薩羅城:其地當在今 Helmund 河流域。或比定其為今 Guzar 城

identification: perhaps the Helmand river
quote: 羅摩印度川:疑指今 Helmund 河

identification: meaning unclear; location undetermined
quote: 弗栗恃薩儻那國:語義不明,學術界就此國方位問題尚無定論
note: Mizutani places it in the Kabul basin; Ji gives no location

identification: location unknown; one view Hupiān/Opian N of Kabul
others_reported: Cunningham: Hupiān/Opian
quote: 方位不明。一說在今阿富汗喀布爾以北之 Hupiān/Opian
note: weaker than Mizutani, who accepts Opian

identification: probably the Khawak pass
quote: 婆羅那大嶺:疑指今Khāwak 山口

identification: Andarāb, the Doshi valley W of the Khawak pass
quote: 為伊朗語Andarāb 之對音, 今 Khāwak 山口以西的 Doshi 河一帶仍稱Andarāb

identification: the Khost river valley (an upper Oxus tributary), NE Afghanistan
quote: 關悉多,今稱 Khost。此國在阿富汗東北部阿姆河上游支流 Khost 河流域

name_in_source: Warwāliz, Valvalij; 遏換城 (舊唐書), 阿緩 (新唐書)
identification: Warwāliz, at the confluence of the Doshi and Taliqan rivers, near Kunduz
others_reported: Yule: Warwāliz; Markwart; Ḥudūd al-ʿālam and Bīrūnī: Valvalij, capital of Tukhāristān; Minorsky
quote: 其地在Doshi 河與 Talaqān 河匯合處,今昆都士(Qunduz)附近
note: Kyoto University excavations of Buddhist sites (水野清一, 文明の十字路). Agrees with Mizutani

identification: the Pamir plateau region
quote: 葱嶺:今帕米爾高原一帶,古稱葱嶺
note: note to Jing Bo's preface, cross-referred from juan 12 and juan 1. Agrees with Mizutani

identification: not to be sought simply at modern Mungān/Munjān but around Khānābād or Taliqan (Markwart)
others_reported: Markwart: Khānābād or Taliqan area; Minorsky
quote: 惟馬迦特認為此地故址不應簡單地從今日之 Mungān 或 Munjān尋求,而應從今日之 Khànàbäd 或 Talaqān 一帶尋求

identification: Ārhan, the Oxus ferry, near (not identical with) Hazrat Imam
others_reported: Markwart: Ārhan = Hazrat Imam; Barthold: two different places; Minorsky (from Iṣṭakhrī): Ārhan near Hazrat Imam
quote: 米諾爾斯基援引阿拉伯地理家伊斯塔赫里(Istakhri)書中有關段落,修正馬迦特之說,指出 Ārhan 實際位于 Hazrät-Imām附近
note: cites Barthold, Turkestan, 4th English ed. 1977 (a reprint). Agrees with Mizutani

identification: Rāwan, N of the Oxus (Markwart)
others_reported: Markwart: 曷邏胡 = Rahula, located at Rāwan next to Ārhan
quote: 馬迦特根據阿利之旁有Rawan的記載,將曷邏胡比定爲縛芻河以北之Rāwan
note: differs from Mizutani (Rāgh, S of the Oxus N of Faizabad)

identification: Kishm, a town on the Kokcha between Faizabad and Taliqan
others_reported: Markwart: Kishm; Minorsky
quote: 馬迦特比定為Kishm…此地當是在 Fayzābad 與 Talaqān之間,沿 Kokcha 河之村鎮

identification: Parghar in Khuttal, N bank of the Oxus where the Parghar (Kchi-Surkhab) river joins it, N of Taliqan
others_reported: Markwart: Parghar; Ḥudūd al-ʿālam: Parghar/Parkhar in Khuttal; Barthold
quote: Parghar 之對音…據波斯佚名作者《世界疆域志》, Parghar/Parkhar 在珂咄羅境内
note: differs from Mizutani, who considers and rejects Parkhar

identification: no location given
others_reported: Markwart: Hematāla, perhaps a rendering of Hephthal
quote: 當是梵文 Himatala 的音譯。馬迦特疑是 Hematāla之對音
note: reads the women's horned headdress as a Hephthalite custom. Mizutani locates it near Darāim; Ji gives no site

identification: Badakhshan: the upper Panj and Kokcha basins
others_reported: Chavannes: a city Badakhshān E of Faizabad = 跋底延 of the Wei shu, distinct from the later country; 内田吟風: 拔底延 = 薄提 = Padiyan 'capital'
quote: 鉢鐸創那國:卽今日之巴達哈商(Badakhshān)地方…近年日人内田吟風主張拔底延與薄提/薄底延同爲 Padiyan之對音
note: post-1971: 内田吟風, 吐火羅國史, 東方學會創立二十五周年東方學論集 1972, 96–97. Agrees with Mizutani

identification: the middle course of the Kokcha above Jurm (old Yamgān/Hamakān)
others_reported: Markwart; Minorsky: middle course of the river that flows through Munjān and is called the Jurm below
quote: 當是 Yamgān 或 Hamakān,位於Kokcha 河流域,該河自 Jarm 以上之上游舊名 Yamgān 或 Hamakān

name_in_source: Kurān; 俱蘭/俱羅弩/俱爛那 (新唐書)
identification: Kurān on the upper Kokcha, the lapis-lazuli district
others_reported: Markwart; Wood; Iṣṭakhrī; Minorsky
quote: 當是穆斯林地理文獻中之Kurān…據烏德(Wood)書, Kokcha 河上游有地,名Kurān

name_in_source: Skt. Dharmasthiti (proposed); Markwart: Iran. *Dar-i Mastit (Mastuj gate); 護密, 鑊侃
identification: Wakhan; the name from *Dar-i Mastit
others_reported: Markwart: *Dar-i Mastit; Chavannes: accepts it as settled
quote: 馬迦特主張這不是該地真實名稱,此名多半出自伊朗語之 * Dar-i Mastit…這個地區基本上就是瓦罕
note: differs from Mizutani on the name (Mizutani doubts Markwart's etymology); same place

identification: Khandūd, on the alluvial fan S of the Āb-i Panja in the Wakhan valley
others_reported: Stein; accepted by scholars
quote: 其地在瓦罕山谷中潘扎水(Āb-i Panja)南岸沖積扇上之 Khandūd,這一比定已爲學者們所接受
note: Ḥudūd al-ʿālam (10th c.) records an idol-temple at Khamdādh. Agrees with Mizutani

name_in_source: *Śikni / Shughnān; 赤匿/式匿 (悟空), 識匿/瑟匿 (新唐書)
identification: Shighnān
quote: 尸棄國:卽*Sikni/Shughnān 對音

name_in_source: 雙靡 (漢書), 賒彌, 舍彌 (魏書); 俱位 (新唐書)
identification: between Mastuj and Chitral; N borders Wakhan, SE Little Bolor
others_reported: Markwart; Chavannes
quote: 其地當在今馬斯圖吉(Mastuj)和特拉爾(Citral)之間

identification: the Pamir (= the 葱嶺 of the two Han shu)
quote: 爲兩《漢書》之葱嶺,《新唐書》之播蜜川,卽今之帕米爾
note: generic, not the specific valley Mizutani gives

name_in_source: 漢盤陁, 渴盤陁, 喝盤陁, 羯盤陁, 渴飯檀; Uigh. (ka)vanta
identification: Tashkurghan; = 蒲犁國 of the Han
quote: 漢代為蒲犁國…卽今之塔什庫爾幹(Tashqurgan)
note: post-1971: Uighur Xuanzang biography fragment, ed. Tugusheva 1980, p.12. Agrees with Mizutani

identification: Qiz-qurghan (princess's fort) in a gorge of the Taghdumbash, which Stein took for the palace on the rock peak
others_reported: Stein (Ancient Khotan I, 35)
quote: 名爲“Qiz-qurghan”,意為“公主堡”
note: reported in the note on 至那提婆瞿呾羅. Agrees with Mizutani

identification: to be sought SE of Tashkurghan (from the bearings)
quote: 當於塔什庫爾干東南方向求之
note: agrees with Mizutani's direction; names no site (neither Kandar Punin nor Stein's Chichiklik)

identification: Yarkand (莎車)
others_reported: Stein: between Yangi Hissar and Yarkand (Pelliot agrees); 白鳥庫吉, Herrmann: Yarkand; others: Chihil Gumbaz NE of Tashkurghan, Ighiz Yar S of Yangi Hissar
quote: 斯坦因以為在今之英吉沙縣(Yangi-Hissar)與莎車/葉爾羌之間…當今莎車縣說爲允當
note: post-1971: Uighur form ušar (Tugusheva 1980, p.14). Agrees with Mizutani

identification: if the capital is Yangi Hissar: Muztagh Ata or better Kongur; if Yarkand (Ji's choice): Khankul, 3459 m, c.50 km W
others_reported: Mizutani
quote: 如以烏鍛國首府比定莎車,則似指其西方約五十公里帕米爾東端之汗庫勒(Khankul, 3459米)山。(參見水谷真成書,頁389)

name_in_source: *Khaṣa; 室利訖栗多底 *śrī-kritāti; 疏勒; Uigh. Käš
identification: Kashgar
others_reported: Herrmann: 疏勒 < Sogdaq (Pelliot: no support); Pelliot: Kašγar = Kaš + yar; Lévi: 佉路數怛勒 = Kharoṣṭra (rejected by Franke, Pischel)
quote: 清代作喀什噶爾,現爲喀什市
note: post-1971: Uighur form Käš (Tugusheva 1980, p.12). Agrees with Mizutani

name_in_source: *čukupa, *čakuka; Khar. Čugupa; Tib. Ču-go-ban; Uigh. Čakuk
identification: Karghalik (葉城)
quote: 據中外學者的考證,斫句迦卽今新疆葉城縣
note: post-1971: Uighur form Čakuk (Tugusheva 1980, p.16). Agrees with Mizutani

name_in_source: Gostana; Khot. Hvaṃna; Tib. Li-yul; Uigh. udun; Turk. qortan
identification: Khotan
others_reported: Pelliot: *Godan, *Gostāna
quote: 卽今之和闐。回鶻文作 udun
note: cites Clauson 1971 on qortan in the Tonyuquq inscription and Tugusheva 1980. Agrees with Mizutani

identification: undecided between Yotkan and the old town of Shisbir
others_reported: Stein, Chavannes, Pelliot, 馮承鈞: Yotkan, 20-odd li SW of Khotan; 黄文弼: Shisbir old town, c.24 km SE of Khotan
quote: 斯坦因、沙畹、伯希和及我國馮承鈞氏均主張在今和闐西南二十餘里的姚頭岡(Yotkan)村。黄文弼則主張在今和闐東南約二十四公里的什斯比爾古城
note: Mizutani gives Yotkan only; Ji also reports Huang Wenbi's Shisbir

identification: not decided: Huang's ruined temple S of Shisbir, or Stein's Chalma-Kazān
others_reported: 黄文弼: ruined temple S of the Shisbir old town (= 贊摩寺 and Faxian's 瞿摩帝寺); Stein: Chalma-Kazān, 13 miles SE of Yotkan
quote: 斯坦因認為今姚頭岡東南十三英里的 Chalma-Kazān 廢址其遺址

identification: Kohmāri Hill, 11 miles SSW of Yotkan, E bank of the Kara-kash (Stein's view preferred)
others_reported: 黄文弼: c.20 li S of the Shisbir old town; Stein: Kohmāri
quote: 據黃文弼考證,此山當在什斯比爾古城南二十里許…斯坦因的比勘似更符合實際情況

identification: perhaps Böwa-kambar, c.4 miles SW of Yotkan (Stein)
others_reported: Stein; Bailey
quote: 該伽藍的位置,斯坦因提示似在姚頭岡西南約四英里的 Böwa-kambar

name_in_source: Bhagai (Julien, Beal), Bhāgya (Watters), both conjectures; Uigh. mirkäy
identification: near Zanguya (藏桂巴扎), SE of Pishan, following 黄文弼
others_reported: Stein: = 勃野 of the Xin Tang shu, near Piālma; 黄文弼: ruins near Zanguya, Pishan
quote: 據他在裝桂牙一帶考古發掘的報告所說…此處黄氏所說的裝桂牙,即今皮山縣東南的藏桂巴扎…黄氏說似更近於事實
note: differs from Mizutani (near Piālma, after Stein). Huang Wenbi, 塔里木盆地考古記 (1958) p.55

identification: Kum-rabat-Pādshāhim Mazār (Kaptar-Mazār), 16 miles E of Piālma
others_reported: Stein
quote: 斯坦因指出今 Piālma 東十六英里的 Kumrabat-Padshāhim Mazār
note: Stein's Dandan-Uiliq panel painting of the legend. Agrees with Mizutani

name_in_source: Samājñā?; Tib. so-ma-ña; = 王新寺 (法顯)
identification: Somiya village, c.1 mile W of Yotkan (Stein)
others_reported: Stein
quote: 斯坦因訂為今姚頭岡西方約一英里之 Somiya 村

identification: Kum-i-Shahidān, c.1 mile SE of Yotkan (Stein)
others_reported: Stein
quote: 其遺址斯坦因比定今姚頭岡東南約一英里的 Kum-i-Shahidān

identification: the Naghara-khāna mound SE of the Aiding-köl lake, SE of Yotkan (Stein)
others_reported: Stein
quote: 在此湖之東南有一當地稱之爲 Naghära-khāna(意為“鼓室”)之大土堆,當爲此“鼓池側伽藍”

identification: Yurung-kash (White Jade river)
quote: 城東南百餘里有大河:當指今玉瓏哈什河

name_in_source: Khot. phimmāṃna; Tib. Phye-ma, bye-ma; Pima; Uigh. bim; Marco Polo Pem/Pein; = 扞彌, 拘彌, 捍麼
identification: the Uzun-Tati – Ulugh-Ziārat area N of Chira (策勒), after Stein; very probably = 坎城 (Kancheng)
others_reported: name from Bhīmā: Watters, 堀謙德, 羽溪了諦; from Tib. bye-ma 'sand': 白鳥庫吉, Stein; = 坎城: Hedin document 24 (Bailey, Khotanese Texts IV, 1961)
quote: 斯坦因考定爲今策勒縣北之 Uzun-Tati 和 Ulugh-Ziārat 地帶…嫓摩城極可能就是坎城
note: does not split 媲摩 and 捍麼 between the two sites as Stein and Mizutani do; adds the 坎城 equation (Bailey 1961)

identification: Kroraina (Loulan), according to some scholars
others_reported: Thomas & Konow; Konow
quote: 有的學者認為來自古代和闐文raurata 之梵文化形式 *rauraka

identification: the Niya site in the desert 65 miles N of Minfeng (Niya); = 精絕 of the Han
others_reported: Stein
quote: 遺址在今民豐縣(現代維吾爾語稱Niya)北六十五英里的沙漠中

identification: Endere ruins (Stein)
others_reported: Stein
quote: 斯坦因考定為現在的安得悦(Endere)
note: Stein's finds incl. a Chinese document of Kaiyuan 7 (719). Agrees with Mizutani

name_in_source: Khot. Calmadana; Uigh. Sarmadan; Tib. Car-čhen; 且末
identification: Cherchen (且末縣), at the present county seat (majority)
others_reported: 謝彬: ruins 15 li S of the town; 陶保廉: old town NW of Cherchen; Grenard: Tatrang 120 li NE
quote: 關於且末古城當今何地,大多數學者主張卽今縣治

name_in_source: Tib. Nob; Uigh. Nop; Lop; Ji: Navāp 'new water'
identification: the Lop region: Charqliq (婼羌) = Nob-chen, Mirān = Nob-chung
others_reported: Beal, Mizutani: Navapa < nava-pura 'new city'; Sogdian na'w+āp 'new water'; Loulan capital: Hedin, Stein (Kroraina N of Lop Nor), Chavannes, 陶保廉 (Charqliq), 馮承鈞 (S of Lop Nor)
quote: 比爾、水谷真成認為納縛波可能是該地的梵文化名稱 Navapa 之音譯…我們認為如果“納縛波”真是一個梵文名稱的話,那麼其原文更可能是Navāp(nava+ap)
note: differs from Mizutani on the name (Navāp 'new water' rather than nava-pura); same place
